status: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY. Episode grouping is a reporting aid. It changes no production behaviour, defines no strategy threshold, and may not be cited as evidence about the one-trade-per-session budget. ALGO-011 §2 and §8.
grouping_rule: (session, direction, legal_route, location_id), new episode when consecutive permission clocks are more than 5 minutes apart
retracted_claim: I previously reported 315 surviving observations against 7 trader trades as a '45:1 permission ratio'. That divided two incommensurable quantities: 315 counts per-decision-clock observations of possibly-persistent setups, 7 counts decisions. GPT ruled it inadmissible and the deduplicated figures below replace it.

what_was_published.where: ALGO-012 section 3, published to the GPT algo branch at 9745ece0

retraction_of_the_2026_08_22_first_run.why_every_number_moved: The X-ray's own ranking step diverged from `kernel._rank_and_yield` in FOUR ways. It kept `survivors[0]` (LIST ORDER, Route A first) where the kernel takes the MAX by (BRK5=3 > BRK15=2 > REV=1, location.quality, location.confluence) - so whenever a breakout coexisted with a reversal the X-ray recorded the OPPOSITE winner from the machine that trades. It had no direction-conflict veto, where the kernel yields NOTHING if both directions have candidates at one clock. It had no decision-clock LAST_ENTRY cutoff (bucket starts are filtered, 1-minute decision clocks inside them were not). And its demotion loop scanned ALL accumulated records for a matching tag, so a tag that WON at an earlier clock was retroactively demoted when the same tag lost at a later one.
retraction_of_the_2026_08_22_first_run.how_it_was_caught: NOT by review. A positive control on a NEW diagnostic - a mirror of Route A that asserted it reproduced the X-ray's survivor tag multiset - refused at the first session with MIRROR_DIVERGED_FROM_XRAY. Investigating which of the two was wrong found it was the X-ray.
retraction_of_the_2026_08_22_first_run.why_the_correspondence_test_did_not_catc: `test_the_xray_consults_every_gate_the_kernel_consults` compares against a HAND-MAINTAINED `SHARED_GATES` tuple, and `_rank_and_yield` was simply not in it. A pinned population that nothing checks for completeness certifies only itself. `_rank_and_yield` is now in the tuple and five arms are red-proofed.
retraction_of_the_2026_08_22_first_run.direction_of_the_error: I OVERSTATED permissiveness by roughly three quarters. The 5B conclusion that Route A dominates SURVIVES - it is still the largest route - but at a smaller magnitude, and every figure I gave for it must be replaced by the ones above.
retraction_of_the_2026_08_22_first_run.what_this_is: The THIRD wrong number I have published on this campaign in two days, after the 0/14 field-name mismatch and the 9/14 session-versus-window join. All three were instrument defects, not strategy defects, and all three were caught by a control rather than by reading the code.
